description:
When you are touring, if you want to include some of the longer tracks then a bike that's equally at home on tarred roads or on tracks makes sense. The Roughstuff bike is the Tourer, but with room for bigger tyres with plenty of mudguard clearance. The bottom bracket is higher for increased pedal clearance, and it's a bit longer to get clearance for wearing boots without hitting the mudguard or panniers.

Full bike builds are available please ring for details or see the Bikes section of the website.

Click here to see a much larger sizing chart.

We have a demonstrator in stock, so please feel free to come to the shop and try one.

Price includes frame and forks. The frame's headtube and BB shell will be faced. Headset not included (Recommended headset: Cane Creek 40 External 1 1/8"). The headset will be fitted if purchased with the frameset.

Downtube Cable Stops are not included. Please order separately if required:

https://www.spacycles.co.uk/m8b0s114p3945/SPA-CYCLES-Downtube-Cable-Stops
